BASTION BELL

3D High-Count Voxel Castle Defense — Menu Controller Nav, P1–P4 Parity, Boss +50%, Snow -50% & Anti-Fall Warp (v27)
🏔️ Island Fortress & Bell Your castle sits on a rocky hill rising out of the water. Shoot the hanging brass bell over the ramp to summon the next wave early!
💣 Frag, Flame & Sticky Thermite Grenades detonate on impact with enemies! Flame grenades ignite fire zones, and Thermite sticks directly to bad guys and burns them down.
🎯 22-Weapon Arsenal, ADS & Attachments Universal Aim Down Sights (2) on all guns (Scopes on Barrett/M24). Loot Minigun, Rocket, Grenade & Mortar Launchers + Silencers, Barrels, Compensators, Lasers & Foregrips!
🎁 Visual Long-Lasting Drops Drops last 2 minutes on the ground! Guns appear as 3D models of the exact weapon, ammo crates say AMMO, and grenades drop as big voxel grenades.
